description: This file contains shell script code for testing corner cases related to identity strings in git commits, including handling of null or empty author and committer names, and validating error messages for malformed identities.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a descriptive name and test commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in error output.

methods.description: Unsets environment variables in a way compatible with the script's environment.
